abstract.text: Plan one round of work, follow it, and keep its history.

inlineContent.text: Only the Project owner can create an Activity.
Open your Project, then Activities.
Tap Activity Actions (the ellipsis), then Add Activity.
Enter a name. Leave Copy set to None to start with an empty plan.
Tap Save.
The Activity begins in Planning. Add
and
before starting.
When creating a new Activity, use Copy to choose what to bring from a Source Activity in the same Project:
None:
Start without Routes or Assignments.
All Routes:
Copy the Routes and Stop order, leaving the Routes unassigned.
All Routes and Assignments:
Also copy the Assignments and their Route connections.
Copied Stops start with Served set to zero. Copy is available when creating an Activity. If the source cannot be copied, correct the problem shown by the app or create without copying.
While the Activity is in Planning, check its Routes and Assignments. The owner can then open More, tap Start, and confirm Start.

Starting locks the planned Routes and Assignments and renews the Activity’s sharing invitation. Previous participants are not carried over. Share the active Activity again with the people who need access; see
Open the active Activity, tap Assignments, and choose an Assignment. Tap Routes and choose a Route to see its Stops. The map follows the work open in the Console.
Save any Route work first. In the active Activity, the owner taps More, then End Activity, and confirms End.

Ending cannot be undone. The Activity becomes read-only, its history is preserved, and existing collaborators lose access to that Activity. The Project and its Locations remain available for your next Activity.

abstract.text: Keep your places together and plan the work around them.
